note: Provenance for skills forked from an upstream source. A fork is edited to fit this repo, so it never tracks upstream automatically. These fields are what makes an upgrade diffable: re-read the source at a newer ref and decide what to carry over.

changes: Added local-docs-first precedence. The installed copy in node_modules wins over Context7, which matters most for Next, where node_modules/next/dist/docs is the exact installed version.
Added the rule that an SDK capability is verified in the published bundle, not from documentation alone.
Kept the three-call cap, the quota handling and the never-silently-fall-back rule.
Cut 57 upstream rules to the 17 that apply to a Next.js App Router stack. Dropped the js-* micro-optimisation category and the SWR rules.
Added a precedence section: under the React Compiler, manual memoisation advice is inverted.
Rewrote every kept rule with our own examples and cross-references.
Added our own rules: no inline functions in JSX, and what suppressHydrationWarning actually does.
Scoped to code comments as well as prose.
Merged with our own comment rules: what and why only, no framework explainers, no history narration, no process references.
Merged with the company writing rules. Where they disagree with upstream the company rules win: a comma, a colon, parentheses or a second sentence may all replace an em dash.
Added an exception to the abstract-metaphor rule for terms a repo uses as names.
